title: connectRefinementlist: hasExhaustiveItems is not documented
body: I don't know what `hasExhaustiveItems` does, since it's not in the documentation. Something to do with search for facet values I think

comments.body: Yes it indicates that the list of elements that you get are exhaustive. This mean that even though you could search, all the values that you could search for are already in the list.
Is that related to search for facet values?
This is still not documented in the new documentation.
Before documenting `hasExhaustiveItems` (and probably other params), I think we should wait to migrate the connector to TypeScript so we have a stable API for the params. WDYT?
